summary: Playoff Bracket Advancement Bug Fix - All 17 Tests PASS. The bug where elimination playoffs did not advance correctly into semifinals has been verified as FIXED. The 8-team bracket now correctly generates 7 matchups (4 QF + 2 SF + 1 Final), simulate-week advances winners to next-round TBD slots with team names, and the final round has is_final=True + bracket='championship' for auto-crown.
critical_code_review_comments: matchups.py lines 256-279: _build_playoff_bracket correctly calculates surviving count - starts with len(round_pairs) (number of round-1 winners), then halves each round. Fixed double-halving bug where surviving was incorrectly halved before the loop.
matchups.py lines 260-274: Final round detection correctly checks 'num_matchups == 1 and surviving <= 2' and sets is_final=True + bracket='championship' on the final matchup document.

matchups.py lines 770-809: simulate_week bracket advancement logic correctly propagates winners to next-round TBD slots - finds sibling matchups in current round, calculates target index (cur_idx // 2), and updates home_team_id/away_team_id with winner ID and name.

matchups.py lines 947-1007: Auto-crown logic correctly triggers when is_final=True and winner exists - sets championship_won_at on winning team, playoff_runner_up_at on loser, creates activity feed and audit log entries.
seed_data_creation: Tests use existing league 69e46af167999bfb85c3962b (Perennial Keepers, 12 teams). Tests reset matchups, week_summaries, and team stats before each bracket test. Cleanup restores league to default state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playoff bracket advancement bug fix verified. Key fixes: (1) _build_playoff_bracket now correctly generates N-1 total matchups for N-team bracket (8 teams = 7 matchups: 4+2+1), (2) simulate_week propagates winners to next-round TBD slots with team names, (3) final round matchups have is_final=True and bracket='championship' for auto-crown trigger.
